description.player_sees: A compact green car with character. The wipers appear to be stuck on.
description.bros_see: A classic European economy car! So authentic! So fuel-efficient!

hidden_issue.seamus_hint: She's reliable. The wipers are a bit... persistent.

description.player_sees: A blue sedan with some scratches. GPS interface looks... temperamental.
description.bros_see: A proper car! Look at this legroom! Perfect for the open Irish roads!

hidden_issue.reveal: GPS starts saying 'recalculating' and never stops in Cloverleaf
hidden_issue.seamus_hint: Good choice. The GPS is... creative near intersections.

description.player_sees: A large SUV. Looks too wide for those narrow country lanes.
description.bros_see: Now THIS is a vehicle! Room for the boys AND our stuff! First class!

hidden_issue.seamus_hint: Roomy. Maybe too roomy for some of the lanes out there.

description.player_sees: A red convertible. Impractical for Irish weather. Sheep seem interested.
description.bros_see: A CONVERTIBLE! In PUBLANDIA! We're going to look SO GOOD in this!

hidden_issue.reveal: Sheep follow the car, block roads, attempt to climb in
hidden_issue.seamus_hint: A beauty. The sheep love her. Be warned.

description.player_sees: A portable GPS unit. Screen looks a bit burned in.
description.bros_see: Perfect! No way we can get lost with this bad boy!

description.player_sees: Comprehensive coverage. Fine print mentions 'circular traffic incidents.'
description.bros_see: Full coverage! Now we're protected no matter what happens!

hidden_issue.fine_print: Section 14.3: Coverage does not extend to incidents occurring within circular traffic patterns, roundabouts, or perpetual vehicular loops.

description.player_sees: Road map of Publandia. One section heavily marked in red with 'HERE BE DRAGONS.'
description.bros_see: Old school navigation! This is how real travelers do it!

hidden_issue.problem: The Cloverleaf is only labeled with '?'
hidden_issue.reveal: Seamus has annotated it but it doesn't help
hidden_issue.seamus_hint: I've marked it up myself. For what good it'll do.

description.player_sees: Simple rosary beads for the dashboard. Seamus seems insistent.

hidden_issue.reveal: Only addon that actually does something
hidden_issue.seamus_hint: Take it. Ye'll need something to hold onto.

description.player_sees: Seamus acknowledges you as survivors. 10% off future rentals.
description.bros_see: This guy loves us! We're practically family now!

post_quest_rewards.seamus_dialogue: Ye've earned my respect. Doesn't mean much. But ye've earned it.
